cp_audit.rule: At least 50*(degree+1) rows, 20 ILs, and half of ILs with >=2*(degree+1) distinct temperatures; maximum cubic.

protocol: Matched extension with scratch, 1M and full-corpus 30.2M initializations; all eleven properties, single/multitask scopes, MLP/equation head families and fitting seeds 42–46. Reuse 200 original models and 15 compatible 1M scale controls; train only 85 additional 1M models. The unchanged trainer, frozen split, target schema, cross-ion attention and maximum per-property sampled-label budget are retained. Static single-task head cells are aliases. Choose individual-task models by validation; choose any shared multitask encoder using the equal-eleven-property validation criterion. Heat-capacity heads also differ in pressure input. The previously inspected test set is descriptive; no universal or monotonic scaling claim.
checkpoint_choice: 1M chosen for this extension using the previous three-property validation ranking; not asserted to be best across eleven properties.
